purpose: Teach: 後援/図表/台数/ターミナル/コーディネーター/歴代/三井/近況

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回のスポーツイベント、後援企業、複数決まったか。
lines.en: Did we lock down multiple sponsors for this sports event?
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Direct eye contact. Expects a straight answer. No wasted breath on formalities.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業計画の図表、明日、共有いたします。
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll share the business plan charts with you tomorrow.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Efficient delivery. Slightly formal — professional distance. Nodding slightly to confirm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社用車、台数、適正か、見直しろ。
lines.en: Review whether our company vehicles are the right number. See if we can optimize.
lines.style: Measured instruction. Light emphasis on 'optimize.' Not harsh — just expects follow-through. Clear delegator.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ターミナル設備、空港との交渉、進めております。
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing negotiations with the airport about terminal facilities.
lines.style: Progress report delivered cleanly. Steady tone — reassuring without overstating. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: イベントコーディネーター、専門家、紹介してもらえ。
lines.en: Get an introduction to an event coordinator — someone with real expertise.
lines.style: Short, clear directive. Light tap of emphasis on 'expertise.' Not demanding, just expects competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。歴代の社長スピーチ、データベース化、進めます。
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on building a database of past company president speeches.
lines.style: Conscientious update. Steady rhythm. Shows he's thinking ahead — detail-oriented without being defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 三井系の企業、提携、検討中だ。
lines.en: We're currently exploring a partnership with a Mitsui-affiliated company.
lines.style: Strategic update, slightly understated. Pause before 'exploring' — signals importance. Composed, informational.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外支社の近況、来週、報告いたします。
lines.en: Yes. I'll report on our overseas branches' status next week.
lines.style: Closing statement. Calm wrap-up rhythm. Respectful finality — no loose ends. Brief.
